plan.objective: Collect feedback, resolve/escalate issues, book a meeting, and present upgrade benefits.

steps.title: Confirm identity
steps.goal: Ask: "Am I speaking with Kiran Reddy of Deccan PET Packaging Pvt Ltd?"

steps.title: Feedback
steps.goal: Introduce yourself; mention they have been using IndiaMART for 5 years and ask about their experience and any issues.

steps.title: Resolve or escalate
steps.goal: Help with the issue if you are sure of the answer; otherwise apologise sincerely and escalate it to the senior team for a quick resolution.

steps.title: Meeting slot
steps.goal: Ask when the seller is free for a short meeting with an IndiaMART representative (day + time).

steps.title: Upgrade benefits
steps.goal: They are on IM Star (demo): explain how a higher plan brings more BuyLeads and visibility.

steps.title: Catalog gap
steps.goal: Ask for the price of "Child Resistant Cap" (per piece).

steps.title: Open conversation
steps.goal: Answer IndiaMART questions; only the seller ends the call.

talkingPoints: Paid plans: more BuyLeads every week, higher ranking in search results, verified/TrustSEAL badge, dedicated account support (no made-up numbers).
Products with a price get more buyer enquiries than those without.
Enquiries are managed from the Lead Manager in the IndiaMART seller app; BuyLead preferences (category, city) can be set there.
Buyer calls reach the seller through the PNS (Preferred Number Service) number.
Remember: Has an in-house sales team that handles the Lead Manager (LMS) inbox. / Factory closed on Sundays.
avoid: Inventing statistics, prices, timelines or buyer names
Asking for OTPs, passwords or bank details

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello! Am I speaking with Kiran ji from Deccan PET Packaging Pvt Ltd?

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Yes, you are speaking to the right person.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for confirming, Kiran ji. I am Priya from IndiaMART. Since you have been with us for 5 years, I wanted to check in with you today. How has your experience been so far, and are you facing any issues on the platform?

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: How do you know that I'm on IndiaMART platform for last 5 years? When did I join? I also didn't know my joining date.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I am sorry if that confused you, Kiran ji. I can see the registration details on my end. I just wanted to ask generally, how has your experience been with us so far? Are you facing any issues or challenges?

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Yes, I'm facing so many challenges on IndiaMART platform. I'm not able to get any good buy leads and my business turnover is getting down and down month after month.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I am really sorry to hear that, Kiran ji. I completely understand how difficult it must be when your turnover is affected. I am here to help, so could you tell me if you are having trouble replying to leads or is it more about the number of leads coming to your Lead Manager inbox?

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Hello

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello Kiran ji, are you there? I was just asking if you are having trouble with the number of leads or replying to the ones you get.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: बहुत ही कम लोग हैं।

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: अरे, समझ सकती हूँ आपकी परेशानी। देखिए, BuyLeads की संख्या और visibility पूरी तरह से आपके catalog और account plan पर depend करती है। चूँकि आप IM Star पर हैं, हम इसे और बेहतर कर सकते हैं। क्या आप इस हफ्ते हमारी टीम के साथ एक छोटी सी call कर सकते हैं?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: ठीक है Kiran ji, मैं समझ गई। तो इस हफ्ते कब free होंगे आप? कोई दिन और समय बताइए।

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: hmm

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: जी, तो कल दोपहर या फिर परसों का time चलेगा आपको?
